name: pyramid-task
description: Plan, assure, and run brownfield changes with scoped guards, conflict-safe parallel batches, sub-agent orchestration, audit gates, and live visualization.

interface.shortDescription: Conflict-safe planning and assurance for agent teams.
interface.longDescription: Turn an intent into a validated pathfinder graph, derive conflict-safe parallel batches, coordinate exact task packets with sub-agents, baseline an existing system, map change impact, isolate task and audit mutation guards, bind inspections to exact implementation events, distinguish source, generated, and evidence-only changes, preserve hash-linked history and durable checked handoffs, migrate active V2 plans without rebuilding, safely transition completed clusters into a new intent, and follow focused task and assurance views live.
defaultPrompt: Turn this feature into an evidence-backed task pyramid.
Assess this existing system and map the change impact before implementation.
Upgrade this running V2.1 plan to V3 without rebuilding it.
Start a new intent after this completed task cluster without losing its history.
Pause this claimed task with a durable handoff, then resume it safely later.
Show what is ready, active, blocked, and unaudited.
Run the current conflict-safe ready batch with sub-agents.
Open a live task visualization and keep it updated while agents work.
Propose and preview a safe expansion for this broad task.
